title: Roo Code shuts down VS Code extension and pivots to Roomote cloud agent
summary: Roo Code, a Cline fork with over three million installs, announced the shutdown of its VS Code extension, cloud service and router to focus on Roomote, a new cloud-based autonomous coding agent. The transcript frames it as part of broader consolidation in AI coding tools.

web_findings.title: Roo Code pivots to cloud-based agent
web_findings.snippet: Roo Code shuts on 15 May 2026; team goes all-in on Roomote.

web_findings.title: Thank you, Roo!
web_findings.snippet: Kilo Code positions itself as migration target.

web_findings.title: Roomote pricing
web_findings.snippet: Roomote billed at $20/month plus $5 per agent-hour, accessible via web, Slack or GitHub.
